relations.text: 主力薬WAKIX(ピトリサント)の独占販売権の導入元
relations.text_en: Licensed it the exclusive rights to pitolisant, sold as WAKIX

source.label: Harmony 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In July 2017, we entered into a License Agreement (as amended, the "2017 LCA") with Bioprojet Société Civile de Recherche ("Bioprojet") whereby we acquired the exclusive right to commercialize the pharmaceutical compound pitolisant.

relations.text: 2023年10月に買収し、ZYN002の権利を取得

source.label: Harmony 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In October 2023, we acquired Zynerba Pharmaceuticals, Inc. ("Zynerba"), adding global rights to develop, manufacture and commercialize ZYN002

relations.text: 候補薬HBS-102を取得し、中華圏の権利は同社に戻す
relations.text_en: Bought HBS-102 from it and granted back Greater China rights

source.label: Harmony 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We acquired full development and commercialization rights for HBS-102 globally, but we have provided an indication-limited grant-back license to ConSynance for the development and commercialization of the Compound in Greater China.

companies.name: ジャズ・ファーマシューティカルズ

relations.text: ナルコレプシー薬Xyremで競合
relations.text_en: Competes through its narcolepsy drug Xyrem

source.label: Harmony 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Jazz Pharmaceuticals' Xyrem (sodium oxybate) is an FDA-approved product for the treatment of cataplexy or EDS in patients 7 years of age and older with narcolepsy.
